scores.note: Option 2 is 0: 'Evidence suggests' hedges the original 'studies have shown' (weaker certainty). Option 5 is 0: 'It is established' boosts certainty and drops the attribution to studies. 1 drops 'can' and softens to 'indicates' (slight drift); 3 'boost' is informal; 4 'supports memory' is vaguer than 'improve'.
